title: Make task stop state understandable in VR
intent: Let the user distinguish a requested stop, a confirmed stop, and a stop that still needs attention while working in VR.
desiredOutcomes: The user can distinguish requested, confirmed, and unresolved stop states in the VR presentation.
The presentation uses the existing provider-neutral orchestrator state without copying chat history or raw logs.
responsibilityBoundary: SampleApp owns VR presentation, spatial state, input, SteamVR/OpenXR integration, and platform window adapters. The coordinator owns task state and cross-project acceptance.
constraints: Do not modify another owning project.
Preserve the semantic difference between requested, confirmed, and unresolved stop states.
Use project-relative artifact references; never embed media bytes.
deliverables: A child-owned implementation and local validation evidence.
